UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Represents a user of the ShuttleScore application and their player profile, storing personal details and links to their match data. This entity supports user account management and personalized performance dashboards.

id.description: Unique identifier for the UserProfile entity.

username.description: A unique, user-chosen display name for the player.

photoURL.description: URL to the user's profile picture.

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the user profile was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the user profile was last updated.

Match.title: Match
Match.description: Records the core details of a single badminton match played.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Match entity.

matchDate.description: The date and time when the match took place.

location.description: The optional location where the match was played.

matchType.description: The type of match played, such as 'Singles', 'Doubles', or 'Mixed Doubles'.

submittedByUserId.description: Reference to the UserProfile who recorded and submitted this match's details.

participantUserIds.description: List of user UIDs involved in the match.

description.description: An optional field for any additional notes or comments about the match.

MatchPlayerStats.title: MatchPlayerStats
MatchPlayerStats.description: Stores individual player statistics and outcome for a specific match.

id.description: Unique identifier for the MatchPlayerStats entity.

matchId.description: Reference to the Match this statistic entry belongs to.

userId.description: Reference to the UserProfile who participated in this match.

sideNumber.description: Indicates which side (e.g., 1 or 2) the player belonged to.

isWinner.description: Boolean indicating if this player's side won the match.

setsWon.description: The number of sets won by this player's side.

setsLost.description: The number of sets lost by this player's side.

totalPointsScored.description: The total points scored by this player's side.

totalPointsConceded.description: The total points conceded by this player's side.

definition.description: Stores the primary details of a badminton match.
